Correlate OTDR events, PM, alarms to identify single root cause.

Link record: SC-03 route_km 10.359. OTDR A shows non-reflective loss 1.47 dB at distance 10.655 km (now) and 10.646 km (night). That's close to SC-03. OTDR B shows loss 1.46 dB at 24.773 km from B (now) and 24.76 km (night). Total fiber distance A to B ~35.4 km including launch/receive cords. 35.432 - 24.773 = 10.659 km from A. Matches.

PM: Rx power dropped from ~-12.1 dBm average 13 Oct-17 to ~-13.5 dBm from 19 Oct onward. Drop ~1.4 dB. Tx stable ~0.8 dBm. Pre-FEC BER degraded from ~1e-15 to ~4e-15 starting 19 Oct. Alarm RX_LOW_WARNING raised 2026-10-19 00:00 UTC.

Site notes: SC-03 re-entered 2026-10-18 23:15 UTC to add branch. That's just before alarm. SC-05 re-entered 2026-10-26 08:30, after alarm already present. So SC-03 is suspect.

OTDR loss at SC-03 is 1.47 dB. Normal splice loss maybe 0.1 dB. So extra ~1.3 dB. Could be bad splice or macrobend? OTDR event is non-reflective loss. Could be a bad splice or macrobend. Location matches splice closure. Need single root cause.

Check other events: SC-01 at 4.445 km loss 0.1 dB normal. SC-02 at 8.483 km loss 0.15 dB normal. SC-04 at 13.28 km loss 0.06 dB normal. SC-05 at 15.486 km loss 0.05 dB (now) or 0.09 dB (night). So fine.

OTDR B night shows an extra event at 30.402 km from A? Wait A night shows event 9 at 30.402 km loss 0.07 dB non-reflective. That's between SC-09 (29.578) and SC-10 (32.052). Maybe slack? But loss small.

The large loss is at ~10.65 km. SC-03 route_km 10.359. Fiber distance ~10.65 km, plausible.

Could be bad splice due to re-entry. Could be macrobend from slack? SC-03 has slack stored ~50 m. Maybe macrobend? The OTDR shows a non-reflective loss of 1.47 dB. Could be a macrobend or bad splice. Bad splice typically non-reflective, loss ~0.5-2 dB. Macrobend also non-reflective.

Site note says splicing crew re-entered closure SC-03 to add a branch. Likely a bad splice.

Fault type options: dirty_connector, damaged_connector, macrobend, bad_splice, fibre_break, wrong_attenuator, tx_degradation.

We have bad_splice at SC-03. Element_id SC-03. Action resplice.

Check if wrong attenuator? B-ATT design 5 dB. No evidence. Tx stable.

Fibre break would be high loss and maybe reflective? Not.

Macrobend could be caused by slack? The closure was re-entered, could have created a bend. However OTDR distance corresponds to splice closure. Could be macrobend within closure. Bad splice is more likely.

Evidence: PM Rx drop 1.4 dB, OTDR loss 1.47 dB at 10.655 km from A, matching SC-03 at 10.359 km. Alarm raised 19 Oct after SC-03 work 18 Oct 23:15.

Need evidence_refs with call_id and exact quote.

Call_id 13: OTDR A now event at distance_km 10.655 loss_db 1.47. Quote.

Call_id 15: OTDR B now event at distance_km 24.773 loss_db 1.46.

Also need link record for SC-03 route_km 10.359. Call_id 2.

Maybe need two measurements. Provide at least two.

Check checklist item 6 correlate. Let's update.
